name: autoflowcut
description: AutoFlowCut - Automate AI image and video creation with Google Gemini/Veo APIs for CapCut projects

scripts.build:prod: vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads
scripts.build:preloads: npm run build:preload && npm run build:flow-preload
scripts.pack: npm run install:platform-binaries && vite build && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run bump:build && npm run install:platform-binaries && vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bump:build && npm run install:platform-binaries && vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run bump:build && npm run install:platform-binaries -- --target=win32-x64 && vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:test: npm run install:platform-binaries && vite build --mode development && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder
scripts.dist:test:mac: npm run install:platform-binaries && vite build --mode development && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:test:win: npm run install:platform-binaries -- --target=win32-x64 && vite build --mode development && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win:nsis: npm run bump:build && npm run mcp:install && npm run install:platform-binaries -- --target=win32-x64 && set VITE_BUILD_TARGET=nsis&& set VITE_FUNCTION_ENV=prod&& vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:appx: npm run bump:build && npm run mcp:install && npm run install:platform-binaries -- --target=win32-x64 && set VITE_BUILD_TARGET=appx&& set VITE_FUNCTION_ENV=prod&& vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads && scripts\buildappx.bat
scripts.dist:win:all: npm run bump:build && npm run mcp:install && npm run install:platform-binaries -- --target=win32-x64 && set VITE_FUNCTION_ENV=prod&& vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run bump:build && npm run mcp:install && npm run install:platform-binaries -- --target=linux-x64 && VITE_FUNCTION_ENV=prod vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:mac:prod: npm run bump:build && npm run mcp:install && npm run install:platform-binaries -- --targets=darwin-x64,darwin-arm64 && VITE_FUNCTION_ENV=prod vite build --mode production && npm run build:preloads && electron-builder --mac --x64 --arm64
